subject: Vendor portal invite failing — invite link stripped by header sanitization (Vanguard Tools)
messages:
From: Emily Carter <emily.carter@vanguardtools.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Issue with supplier invite — redirect strips headers

Hi David,

We received the supplier invite for Vanguard Tools but several users report a login loop when they click the activation link. Our engineering team captured the browser console and the SSO proxy logs; it looks like the redirect to Zip's onboarding endpoint is losing the x-forwarded-host and utm query parameters somewhere in your frontend chain, turning the accept link into a bare path that returns a 400.

Quick summary:
- Affected users: 4 (two on Chrome 118/macOS, two on Android)
- Symptom: click invite -> briefly hits redwood-invite.redwood.ai -> redirects to zip.onboard/accept -> returns 400 / login loop
- We see header sanitization on the redirect (x-forwarded-host removed).

I attached a screenshot and a header-dump from one of the Chrome devtools captures. We have a PO pending (PO# VT-4451) and are blocked from completing vendor setup. Can your team confirm whether any proxy / CDN layer is removing forwarded headers for invite links?

Thanks — this is time-sensitive for our finance team.

Emily Carter
Vendor Ops | Vanguard Tools
emily.carter@vanguardtools.com
+1 (415) 555-0122

Attachments: invite-click-screenshot.png, zip-invite-headers.txt

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@vanguardtools.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Issue with supplier invite — redirect strips headers

Hi Emily — thanks for the detailed repro and attachments.

We're sorry you're blocked — we understand how urgent a PO hold is. Initial thoughts: our edge CDN has a header-sanitization rule that should not strip x-forwarded-host for known invite paths, but it's possible the invite link contains an extra query string (utm_campaign) that triggers a normalization rule on the redirector.

Next steps from our side (I'll coordinate these internally and report back by EOD PT):
1) I asked Ben (SRE) to check the redirector logs for the three invite token IDs you attached.
2) Kimberly (Seller Ops) — can you confirm if there's an alternate invite we can issue (no UTM) so Vanguard can finish onboarding while we debug?
3) Emily — could you paste one full failing invite URL (exact value) into a reply or the zipped header file? The header dump helps but we need the exact query string ordering.

I'll escalate to infra if this is a routing rule. Apologies for the friction — we'll prioritize.

Best,
David
Director, Partner Integrations | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Emily Carter <emily.carter@vanguardtools.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2027 11:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Issue with supplier invite — redirect strips headers

Looping in infra — I pulled the token id Emily referenced and grepped the redirector logs. Quick notes:
- Redirector saw the initial hit with full query string: /invite/accept?token=eyJ...&utm_source=email
- The service that issues 302 to zip.onboard/accept runs a sanitization filter; at scale we recently tightened allowed headers because of a CVE in an older proxy lib. Looks like that filter is stripping x-forwarded-host on redirect responses when certain query args match a regex (utm_|campaign_).
- I will open an infra patch to relax header removal for /invite/accept paths and add a toggle so we can roll fast.

Kimberly — for vendor setup, if we can generate a
